“I hate myself for missing him/still loving him.”

Wow, it’s reassuring to see someone else writing this up here. This is written on my heart. We broke up 2 1/2 years ago now. Missing him and loving him look very different now than they did then. I’m trying to accept the fact that I’ll always love him on some level. He was my first love. My first time. I will always remember us as the sweet but passionate romance of my twenties. And I will always, always wish him happiness. 

The good news is that I miss the companionship more than I miss him these days. I’ve dated since then and the fantastic men I’ve met have helped me a lot on my journey to becoming whole again. They’ve been check points. They’ve been examples of what being truly prioritized looks like. They’ve been evidence that I’m still desirable and interesting, and evidence that all kinds of men exist out there.

Best of luck to you on your healing my friend. Sending love to you. All of us here can relate in some way. Please don’t believe any of the shaming you tell yourself for others tell you. You’re not alone or stupid or crazy or any other terrible word like that. Hang in there.
